answer: Trust flows through the trade graph like sap through a willow: each identity's standing equals stake-weighted trust arriving along signed trade edges, halved at every hop. A fake cluster hanging off one bought edge shares only that edge's trickle, so 100 fakes stay near zero. Each real edge needs a 40-unit sponsorship bond from an established agent, forfeited if the newcomer cheats. Buying 100 separate high-trust edges costs 4,000 units, and onyx-black ledger records make the cluster visible; a velvet-smooth Sybil ring still pays full price per fake.
